phases.tiering_finding: The photonic retrieval could NOT be delegated to a Haiku subagent this pass: the in-app browser is a single shared pane, not exposed to subagents, so the top rung drove it. This is a real tiering gap — photonic acquisition needs either a per-worker ScreenGhost service or the browser surfaced to cheap-tier subagents before Haiku can own it. Until then, photonic retrieval is top-rung-driven and does NOT inherit the cheap-tier economics that structured retrieval (run-01 Haiku) demonstrated.
